from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,itertools,json,resource,signal,sys,time,traceback
import sympy as s
from sympy.polys.matrices import DomainMatrix
ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'code'))
from classification_three_hyperplanes_quadric_independent import ambient_matrices
from classification_rank3_mixed_component_review import COLUMNS,ROWS,sparse,vector,jacobi
JOB=ROOT/'research/classification/jobs/unimodular_pole_single_orbit_one_ambient.json';job=json.loads(JOB.read_text())
for q in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/q['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==q['sha256'],q['path']
frozen=json.loads((ROOT/'research/classification/inputs/unimodular_pole_single_orbit_one_ambient_caller_20261108.json').read_text());assert hashlib.sha256(frozen['inline_source'].encode()).hexdigest()==frozen['inline_source_sha256']
OUT=ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_UNIMODULAR_POLE_SINGLE_ORBIT_ONE_AMBIENT_20261108.json';assert not OUT.exists();start=time.monotonic();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
def timeout(*_):raise TimeoutError('ONE forcedcanonical sameorbit total180s; no alternatepoint/profile/jet')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,timeout);signal.alarm(180)
def encode(A):return{'shape':list(A.shape),'entries':{str(i)+','+str(j):str(v)for(i,j),v in A.todok().items()}}

def certificate(A):
 dm=DomainMatrix.from_Matrix(A).convert_to(s.QQ);rr,piv=dm.rref();piv=list(piv);rows=list(dm.extract(range(A.rows),piv).transpose().rref()[1]);assert len(rows)==len(piv);free=[j for j in range(A.cols)if j not in piv];K=s.zeros(A.cols,len(free));red=rr.to_Matrix()
 for k,j in enumerate(free):
  K[j,k]=1
  for i,lead in enumerate(piv):K[lead,k]=-red[i,j]
 assert A*K==s.zeros(A.rows,K.cols)and K[free,:]==s.eye(len(free));det=A.extract(rows,piv).det(method='domain-ge');assert det
 return{'rank':len(piv),'nullity':len(free),'minor_rows':rows,'minor_columns':piv,'minor_determinant':str(det),'free_columns':free,'complete_kernel_sparse':encode(K),'all_original_rows_annihilate_kernel':True,'kernel_free_identity':True}
result={'task_id':'E_multiple_hyperplane','all_exact_arithmetic_passed':False,'failure':None,'same_forced_canonical_orbit_only':True,'new_point_series_or_higher_jet':False,'stage':'input_source'}
try:
 point=json.loads((ROOT/'research/classification/inputs/unimodular_pole_forced_canonical_point_20261108.json').read_text());assert point['integer_scale']==1
 h,x,y,z,w=xx=s.symbols('h x y z w');env={str(q):q for q in xx};env.update({str(q):q for q in s.symbols('n0:5')+s.symbols('a0:2')});bind={env[k]:s.Rational(v)for k,v in point['complete_source_specialization'].items()}
 old=json.loads((ROOT/point['old_full_source_report']).read_text());cs=[c for c in old['cases']if c['name']==point['old_source_case_name']];assert len(cs)==1;case=cs[0]
 reconstructed=[s.expand(sum(s.sympify(case[k][i],locals=env)for k in ['highest_bivector','normal_linear_bivector','constant_source']).subs(bind))for i in range(6)]
 expected=[s.sympify(q,locals=env)for q in point['affine_brackets']];assert reconstructed==expected
 P=s.zeros(5)
 for ij,f in zip(itertools.combinations(range(1,5),2),reconstructed):
  i,j=ij;P[i,j]=s.expand(h*h*f.subs({q:q/h for q in xx[1:]},simultaneous=True));P[j,i]=-P[i,j]
 assert all(c.q==1 for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)for c in s.Poly(P[i,j],*xx).coeffs())
 ps=sparse(P,xx);assert jacobi(ps)==s.zeros(350,1)and all(not a for a in jacobi(ps,raw=True).values())
 div=[s.expand(sum(s.diff(P[i,j],xx[i])for i in range(5)))for j in range(5)];assert div==[0]*5
 M5=sorted({tuple(c.count(i)for i in range(5))for c in itertools.combinations_with_replacement(range(5),5)},reverse=True);assert len(M5)==126
 pfs={};DD=0
 for i in range(5):
  j,k,l,t=[q for q in range(5)if q!=i];pf=s.expand(P[j,k]*P[l,t]-P[j,l]*P[k,t]+P[j,t]*P[k,l]);pfs[str(i)]=str(pf);DD+=(-1)**i*xx[i]*pf
 DD=s.expand(DD);assert DD==h**5;poly=s.Poly(DD,*xx)
 result.update({'point':point,'full150_point':list(map(str,vector(ps))),'complete_homogeneous_integer_brackets':{str((i,j)):str(P[i,j])for i in range(5)for j in range(i+1,5)},'all10_strict_and350_original_Jacobi_zero':True,'homogeneous_modular_vector':list(map(str,div)),'all_five_four_by_four_Pfaffians':pfs,'actual_signed_Euler_Pfaffian':str(DD),'full126_quintic_order':[list(e)for e in M5],'full126_quintic_coefficients':[str(poly.coeff_monomial(e))for e in M5],'stage':'full_ambient_matrices'})
 D,V,M,extra=ambient_matrices(P,xx,[P]);assert extra==M.row_join(M[:,-1]);assert D*M==s.zeros(350,51)
 mats={'D350x150':D,'Euler150x25':V,'Euler_GL_scalar150x51':M};result['complete_sparse_matrices']={q:encode(A)for q,A in mats.items()};result['certificates']={};result['stage']='full_certificates'
 for name,A in mats.items():result['certificates'][name]=certificate(A)
 dr=result['certificates']['D350x150']['rank'];vr=result['certificates']['Euler150x25']['rank'];mr=result['certificates']['Euler_GL_scalar150x51']['rank'];assert vr==24 and dr+mr<=150
 result.update({'all350_D_times_full51_group_columns_zero':True,'projective_tangent_dimension':125-dr,'actual_point_orbit_dimension':mr-25,'normal_tangent_gap':150-dr-mr,'full_orbit_closure_smooth_unique_component_candidate':dr+mr==150,'known_component_or_newness_not_asserted':True,'classification_outcome':'smooth_unique_actual_orbit_closure_component_candidate_pending_prior_and_independent_review'if dr+mr==150 else'exact_local_route_nonclosing_STOP_no_more_points_or_jets','all_exact_arithmetic_passed':True,'stage':'complete','coefficient_order':[{'pair':list(ij),'exponent':list(e)}for ij,e in COLUMNS],'equation_order':[{'quad':list(q),'exponent':list(e)}for q,e in ROWS]})
except BaseException:result['failure']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
 signal.alarm(0);result.update({'inline_source':frozen['inline_source'],'inline_source_sha256':frozen['inline_source_sha256'],'input_bindings':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss})
 with OUT.open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 print(json.dumps({k:result.get(k)for k in ['all_exact_arithmetic_passed','projective_tangent_dimension','actual_point_orbit_dimension','normal_tangent_gap','classification_outcome','stage','seconds','maximum_RSS_KiB','failure']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
if not result['all_exact_arithmetic_passed']:raise RuntimeError(result['failure'])
